clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, hunters bring Lakota'mani's hoof to Jorn Skyseer after the hunt. The offering honors the mighty kodo's spirit and marks the hunter as an equal to its strength.

Among the Barrens herds, Lakota'mani is a kodo of great size and endurance. In Taur-ahe, the tauren tongue, his name means “Earthshaker,” and his steps rumble across the plains. Tauren hunters track and defeat such a beast not for slaughter, but to meet the raw vigor of Kalimdor's wildlife in a sacred hunt.

When you bring Lakota'mani's hoof to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo, the hunt reaches its close. Jorn sees a new power and stride in hunters who return from the encounter. Presenting the trophy earns his blessing, honoring Lakota'mani's courage and primal spirit as companions on your path.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Hoof of Lakota'mani is a symbol of the strength of the great kodo.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride. Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Lakota'mani is called "Earthshaker" in our language, and his steps are like gathered thunder. He is with you now, and his courage mingles with yours. Together there is no conflict you cannot face.
Walk tall, friend. Walk tall, Earthshaker.
